name: Medium turbo kit
_note: A medium turbo kit for any engine without one: more boost, later — it needs forged internals and a clutch to hold it.

sound._note: The turbo's whistle (testtrack/audio.js), only heard with it fitted: its pitch follows the shaft speed — the spool, which chases the boost this turbo's curve gives at the revs times how open the throttle is, spoolUp s to rise and spoolDown s to fall — from fromHz to toHz at full boost; its level (gain at full boost) follows the spool and the throttle, so it rises under throttle and fades off it; noise: how much rushing air there is round the tone, q how narrow it is.
